title: repo-maintainer target repository configuration
description: Schema for config/repos.json. Per-repository blocks are deep-merged over 'defaults', so any subset of these keys may be overridden per repository. Note: draft-07 evaluates 'additionalProperties' per schema object, so a repository entry cannot be composed from a strict base object plus an identity object with allOf; 'defaults' and 'repository' therefore enumerate the shared keys explicitly.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

schema_version.description: Configuration schema version. Only 1 is supported.

repositories.description: Target repositories. Names must be unique.

defaults.description: Base settings deep-merged into every repository entry.

repository.description: One target repository: an identity block plus any subset of the shared settings.

notes.description: Free-form operator note explaining the entry.

enabled.description: Whether this repository takes part in runs at all.

curator.description: Binds this repository to a daily autonomous expansion recipe from curators/. Required for mode 'curate'. The recipe id must be registered in curators.REGISTRY; an unknown id is rejected by load_config and by --check-only.

recipe.description: Curator recipe id. Known ids: web-templates, ai-arsenal, gitscour, ai-daily, toolscour.

options.description: Recipe-specific knobs, read through CurationRecipe.option(). 'llm': false forces the deterministic offline path for this repository.

enabled.description: Set false to keep the block as documentation while skipping curation for this repository.

notes.description: Free-form operator note about what the recipe does each day.

modes.description: Per-phase enablement. A disabled phase is skipped for this repository.

observer.description: Phase 1: read-only health and staleness audit.

pr.description: Phase 2: automated non-destructive upkeep on a chore/daily-maintenance-* branch.

feature.description: Phase 3: feature proposals and skill expansion.

curate.description: Phase 4: autonomous daily expansion via the repository's curator recipe, delivered on a chore/daily-curation-* branch.

stale_days.description: Days without a commit before the repo is flagged critical.

warn_stale_days.description: Days without a commit before a warning is raised.

stale_pr_days.description: Days without PR activity before a PR is flagged stale.

stale_branch_days.description: Days without commits before a remote branch is flagged stale.

outdated_major_is_urgent.description: Report outdated major versions as critical rather than warning.

setup_guide_globs.description: Repository-relative paths accepted as a setup or contributing guide.

skip_link_prefixes.description: Link prefixes excluded from the broken-link check.

skip_link_suffixes.description: Link suffixes excluded from the broken-link check.

skip_link_domains.description: External domains excluded from link checking.

auto_bump_patch.description: Allow automatic patch-level bumps in Phase 2.

allow_major_bumps.description: Allow major bumps. Leave false: majors can break callers.

max_bumps_per_run.description: Upper bound on dependency bumps applied in one run.

quality.description: Formatting, linting, and test validation settings.

run_tests_on_pr.description: Run the test suite before opening a Phase 2 pull request.

skills.description: Phase 3 skill discovery, staging, and generation settings.

labels.description: Labels applied to pull requests when they already exist in the repo.
